themes.name: fan sketchbook
themes.prompt: You receive 2 images: Image 1 is a blank white page (or ignore it). Image 2 is the user's photo — use their face, features, hair, and identity as the CHARACTER reference for the entire sketchbook page. ===== CONCEPT ===== Generate an illustration that looks like an OBSESSED FAN ARTIST filled an entire sketchbook page with drawings of the person from Image 2. The page should feel like chaotic, passionate, messy fan art — NOT clean or organized. ===== WHAT TO DRAW ===== Draw the person from Image 2 MULTIPLE TIMES on the same page in different styles and poses: (1) 2-3 FULL-BODY POSES in different dynamic angles — standing, sitting, walking, leaning, one hand on hip, peace sign, looking over shoulder. Dress them in trendy aesthetic clothes (oversized hoodie, plaid skirt, cropped jacket, platform shoes, layered accessories — use a soft pastel color palette). (2) 2-3 TINY CHIBI / SD versions scattered around — super deformed, big head small body, cute exaggerated expressions (angry pout, heart eyes, sleeping, eating snack). (3) 2-3 RANDOM CLOSE-UPS — just their eyes with detailed sparkle/reflection, just their hands holding a drink or making a gesture, just their side profile. (4) EXAGGERATED EXPRESSIONS — one face doing a dramatic shocked look, one doing a soft dreamy smile, one doing an annoyed pout with puffed cheeks. (5) DOODLES AND ANNOTATIONS scattered everywhere — tiny hearts, stars, arrows pointing to details with notes like 'so pretty!!', 'this angle!!', 'perfect', sparkle effects, flower doodles, small music notes, exclamation marks. ===== LAYOUT ===== WHITE BACKGROUND — like a real sketchbook page. NO GRID, NO ORDER, NO SYMMETRY — pure chaos energy. Drawings should OVERLAP each other messily, some tilted at angles, some partially cut off at edges. Some bigger, some tiny. Some detailed, some rough sketchy. Pencil construction lines visible on some. Some colored, some line art only. ===== ART STYLE ===== Anime/manga illustration — clean but expressive linework. Mix of detailed semi-realistic anime (main poses), chibi/SD (small ones), rough sketch (gesture drawings). Pencil + ink + selective color. ===== FACE ACCURACY ===== Every drawing must clearly be the SAME PERSON from Image 2. Face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, hairstyle, hair color consistent and recognizable across all drawings. ===== OUTPUT ===== One single sketchbook page, white background, filled edge-to-edge with overlapping drawings. Pure creative chaos.
